findings.title: Keep the registered metric alert handler instantiable
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits abstract methods from StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none of them: counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data remain abstract. MetricAlertFire still registers this class as its handler, so accessing detector.detector_handler for a metric_alert_fire detector now raises TypeError instead of returning the previous no-op handler. This also aborts process_detectors before subsequent detectors can be processed. Keep the concrete no-op implementation until the stateful methods are implemented, or implement all required methods here.
